title: Sum of Two Numbers
description:
# Sum of Two Numbers

Read two integers, each on its own line, and print their sum.

## Input

Two lines, each containing one integer.

```
3
4
```

## Output

A single line: the sum of the two integers.

```
7
```

## Hints

- `input()` reads one line as a string.
- `int(...)` converts a string to a number.
- `print(...)` writes a line of output.
starterCode:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())

# TODO: print the sum of a and b
hints: Read each line as a number, then add them.
`input()` gives you a string; wrap it in `int(...)` to get a number you can add.

```
read a
read b
print a + b
```
